name: headphones
description: For headphones: mixes a little of each side into the other, as speakers do, and widens or narrows the stereo image.

crossfeed.label: Crossfeed
crossfeed.description: How much of the left channel reaches the right ear and the other way round. Takes away the hard left and right of old recordings. 0 is off.

width.label: Stereo width
width.description: 100 is unchanged, 0 is mono, 200 is as wide as it gets.
